source.description: Recorded reference with explicit engineering error budgets. Supported harmonic balance, standard tuning, calibrated A3 levels, comparable same-note wave levels, mixer/noise and XMOD checks remain strict. Reference signed cycles, intermediate saw-family levels, waveform absolute levels outside the calibrated pitch and spectral bands from 4 kHz upward are diagnostics. Pure SYNC rejects unwanted 20-80 Hz energy instead of requiring reference foldback. Independent engine tests protect the preserved signed waveform model. No per-case path fitting; numeric reference, budgets and fixed calibration are unchanged. Exact policy is documented beside the measurements.

dsp.calibration: Fixed A3 VCO1 saw path offset measured against the reference at unchanged source revision 08b5bf0; capture WAV SHA-256 6a07033718323ad5f8037c5f50e908e19a8b9fef5bc905dd2cf37c96e5f19f82. Never refit during assertion runs. Fixed cycle polarity: retained asymmetric waves from both VCOs at A1/A3/A5 establish rising DSP saws opposite to the reference's falling output saws.
